claims.text: Andaman Polymer Group operates the Map Ta Phut PP 1 plant at Map Ta Phut, Thailand, with a polypropylene capacity of 350.0 kta, using a Gas Phase process route.
The Map Ta Phut PP 1 plant started up in 2016 and is currently operating.
Andaman Polymer Group operates the Map Ta Phut PP 2 plant at Map Ta Phut, Thailand, with a polypropylene capacity of 250.0 kta, using a Gas Phase process route.
The Map Ta Phut PP 2 plant started up in 2020 and is currently operating.
Andaman Polymer Group has the Map Ta Phut PP 3 plant under construction at Map Ta Phut, Thailand, with a planned polypropylene capacity of 300.0 kta, using a Gas Phase process route.
The Map Ta Phut PP 3 plant is scheduled to start up in 2028 and is currently under construction.

coverage_note: All claims are directly supported by plant register data filtered by company, product, and country. No evidence was found for additional assets or lines beyond the three listed.
